query: how to send new hubspot contacts to slack
title: How to send new HubSpot contacts to Slack | 50agents
description: Send new HubSpot contacts to Slack with a workflow (Professional plans) or an automation tool: trigger on new contacts only, filter, pick the fields.
h1: How to send new HubSpot contacts to Slack
answer: HubSpot’s free Slack app does not post new contacts, so you need either a HubSpot workflow with the "Send a Slack notification" action, which needs a Professional or Enterprise plan, or an automation tool that watches HubSpot for new contacts and posts to a channel.
Whichever you use, filter to the contacts someone should act on and say who owns each one, or the channel turns into noise within a week.

sections.h2: Your three options, and what each needs

head: Option
Needs
Posts new contacts?
rows: No. It sends mentions, form submissions, task assignments, chats and activity on linked records.
A HubSpot workflow with "Send a Slack notification"
Yes, with properties, @mentions of the owner and buttons.
A HubSpot connection and a Slack connection
Yes, from a trigger on new contacts.

body.p: If you already pay for a HubSpot Professional hub, the workflow is the cleanest route: HubSpot decides who is new, and you enrol only the contacts you care about. On a free or Starter plan, an automation tool is the way.
If the only thing you want is to hear about form fills, check the free notifications first: form submissions are on the list, and they need no workflow at all.

sections.h2: Choose the trigger carefully: new, or new or updated

body.p: Most tools offer two HubSpot triggers that sound alike. Zapier lists both "New Contact" and "Contact Recently Created or Updated". The second fires every time a property changes, so one contact can post five times in a day.

In viaSocket’s catalog, which 50agents uses, HubSpot’s contact trigger is "New Or Updated Contact". When the only trigger fires on updates too, add a check right after it that keeps only contacts created since the last run. Every tool can do this with a filter on the create date.

method.h2: How to set it up, step by step

steps.title: Decide which contacts deserve a ping
steps.body: All new contacts is rarely right. Pick a rule a salesperson would agree with: from a form, lifecycle stage Lead or later, a country you sell in, or a company email domain.

steps.title: Create the channel and add the app to it
steps.body: A dedicated channel such as #new-leads keeps alerts out of chat. For a private channel, add the HubSpot or automation app to the channel first, or posts fail without a sound.

steps.title: Set the trigger and the filter
steps.body: Trigger on new contacts. If your tool only has new or updated, filter on create date. Then add your rule from step 1 as a second filter.

steps.title: Write the message
steps.body: Name, company, email, source, and the owner. Four or five fields read at a glance; fifteen do not. Put a link to the contact record last so people can click through.

steps.title: Handle empty fields
steps.body: A contact with no company or no owner prints a blank. Give each field a fallback ("no company given", "unassigned") so the message still reads.

steps.title: Test with a real contact, then watch the first day
steps.body: Create a test contact that matches the rule and one that does not. Check that only one posts, then delete both.

body: In 50agents you describe it to Captain in one sentence, and it plans an automation: the same steps every time, no AI needed on each run. It reads one real contact from your HubSpot to plan the fields, tests the steps on it with every send held back, and leaves the automation as a draft until you make it live.

One thing to know before you build it here: 50agents treats a post to a Slack channel as reaching other people, so today each post waits in Needs you for your yes. Adding the row to your sheet runs on its own. If you want posts with no approval, a HubSpot workflow or another automation tool fits this job better.

wrong.title: A CSV import floods the channel
wrong.body: Importing 400 contacts creates 400 new contacts. Pause the automation before a big import, or filter out the import source.

wrong.title: One contact posts again and again
wrong.body: The trigger fires on updates. Filter on create date, or switch to a new-only trigger if your tool has one.

wrong.title: Nothing arrives in a private channel
wrong.body: The app was never added to the channel. Add it, then send a test.

wrong.title: Nobody is tagged
wrong.body: New contacts often have no owner yet, so the @mention is empty. Post to the channel and let the owner field read "unassigned" until routing runs.

wrong.title: Personal data in a busy channel
wrong.body: Phone numbers and notes in a 60-person channel are more exposure than the job needs. Post the name, company and a link; keep the rest in HubSpot.

faqs.q: Can HubSpot notify Slack about new contacts without Zapier?
faqs.a: Yes, with a workflow and the "Send a Slack notification" action, on a Professional or Enterprise plan. The free Slack notifications cover form submissions and mentions, not every new contact.

faqs.q: Can I post only qualified leads?
faqs.a: Yes. In a HubSpot workflow, set the enrolment rule on lifecycle stage or lead status. In an automation tool, add a filter step after the trigger.

faqs.q: Can I tag the contact owner in the message?
faqs.a: HubSpot’s own workflow action can @mention the record owner, for users who have mapped their email. In other tools, look up the owner’s Slack user from their email, or post their name as text.
